tasks.title: ChatContextBuilder + slash parser + tests
tasks.description: Create Sources/Zion/Services/ChatContextBuilder.swift with: `struct ChatContextBuilder { let worker: RepositoryWorker }`. Add nested `enum SlashCommand: Equatable { case diff; case log; case status; case file(path: String); case commit(sha: String) }`. Add `static func parseSlashCommand(_ line: String) -> SlashCommand?` (pure; line-anchored regex `^\s*/(diff|log|status|file|commit)(\s+(.+))?$`; rejects unknown; rejects file/commit without args). Add `func gitContextHeader(repoURL: URL, branch: String) async -> String` (calls worker `rev-parse --short=7 HEAD` and `status --porcelain | wc -l`; formats L10n chat.contextHeader with repo name (URL last component), branch, SHA or `?` on failure, uncommitted count). Add `func expandSlashCommands(_ text: String, repoURL: URL) async -> String` (scans lines, replaces each matching slash line with appended fenced block of git output truncated to AILimits.maxDiffContentLength / maxCommitLogLength / maxFileContentPreviewLength; safe path resolution for /file — rejects outside-repo with L10n chat.slash.fileOutsideRepo line; empty diff outputs L10n chat.slash.empty.diff). Inline-slash inside URLs MUST NOT match — line anchored regex. Write Tests/ZionTests/ChatSlashCommandParserTests.swift (7 cases per AC4) and Tests/ZionTests/ChatContextBuilderTests.swift (7 cases per AC5; use temp git repo via GitTestHelper pattern, find existing helper or create simple seed).

tasks.title: ChatService + tests
tasks.description: Create Sources/Zion/Services/ChatService.swift: `@MainActor @Observable final class ChatService`. Stored: `var thread: ChatThread`, `var isStreaming: Bool = false`, `@ObservationIgnored private var activeTask: Task<Void, Never>?`, `@ObservationIgnored private let ai: AIClient`, `@ObservationIgnored private let worker: RepositoryWorker`, `@ObservationIgnored private let contextBuilder: ChatContextBuilder`, `@ObservationIgnored private let streamProvider: ((LocalLLMConfig, AIPromptPayload, Int, String) -> AsyncThrowingStream<String, Error>)?` (optional injection for tests). Init takes ai, worker, contextBuilder; init-overload accepts streamProvider for tests. Methods: `func send(text:provider:apiKey:mode:repoURL:branch:) async` — appends user ChatMessage, expands slash commands via contextBuilder, prepends gitContextHeader to FIRST user msg of payload, builds AIPromptPayload via AIClient.makePromptPayload, appends pending assistant ChatMessage(isStreaming: true). If provider == .local: stream via AIClient.streamLocalLLM (or injected provider) and update last msg content per delta on main actor; else fall back to AIClient.call(...) non-streaming and atomic-replace. Sets isStreaming = false on completion/cancel/error. On AIError: replace pending message with system error message using L10n chat.error.send.title + localizedDescription. `func newThread()` — replaces thread with fresh empty ChatThread. `func stop()` — cancels activeTask, flips isStreaming to false, leaves partial content in last message. Write Tests/ZionTests/ChatServiceTests.swift (4 cases per AC6: testSendAppendsUserAndAssistantMessages, testStopCancelsActiveTask, testNewThreadClearsMessages, testStreamingTokenAppendUpdatesLastMessage) — inject mock streamProvider returning canned AsyncThrowingStream.

tasks.title: ChatMessageBubble view
tasks.description: Create Sources/Zion/Views/Chat/ChatMessageBubble.swift: `struct ChatMessageBubble: View`. Takes a ChatMessage. User messages: right-aligned (HStack { Spacer(); content }), brand-tinted background (DesignSystem.Colors.brandPrimary.opacity via existing token — find an existing semantic token, do NOT use raw .opacity literal). Assistant messages: left-aligned, surface-tinted background (DesignSystem.Colors.glassHover or similar surface token). Assistant content rendered as markdown via AttributedString(markdown: content). On AttributedString failure, fall back to plain Text. Use DesignSystem.Typography.body for content, DesignSystem.Typography.codeMono for fenced code segments if reachable via attributed-string runs (otherwise body is acceptable v1). NO hardcoded colors, fonts, or cornerRadius literals — all via DesignSystem tokens. Add subtle isStreaming indicator (blinking dot or ProgressView) when message.isStreaming == true.

tasks.title: ChatScreen view (composition)
tasks.description: Create Sources/Zion/Views/Chat/ChatScreen.swift: `struct ChatScreen: View`. Inputs: `@Bindable var chat: ChatService`, repoURL: URL?, branch: String. Holds composer text via @State. Reads provider/apiKey/mode via @AppStorage matching existing RepositoryViewModel+AI.swift conventions (find via grep). Layout: VStack { ScrollViewReader { ScrollView { LazyVStack of ChatMessageBubble OR ChatEmptyState when messages.isEmpty }; ChatComposer pinned bottom }.
